chunks: "The houses in which salat (prayer) is performed at night, their light shines for the inhabitants of the heaven just as the light of the stars shines for the inhabitants of the earth."

key_terms.الْبُيُوتَ: the houses or homes being described

ai.seo_question: How are houses that are enlivened by night salat (prayer) described in hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the spiritual radiance of homes in which salat (prayer) is performed during the night. It emphasizes the lofty rank of night worship and portrays such houses as visibly illuminated to the inhabitants of the heavens.
